It generates $\eta_1, \eta_2$, computes $\theta = \arccos(1 - 2\eta_1)$ and $\phi = 2\pi\eta_2$, then constructs $Y = (R\sin\theta\cos\phi, R\sin\theta\sin\phi, R\cos\theta) + C$.
